races.title: Weatherbys & Birdie Calendars Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A match on paper between GINOLO and Mysterland , with marginal preference for the former who pulled clear with a promising sort on debut at Worcester last month. Charlie Longsdon's charge showed a good attitude to get off the mark at Sedgefield last month and he won't allow the selection to have it all his own way. GINOLO (IRE) MYSTERLAND (FR) AR AGHAIDH LEAT (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Mysterland (5/4), Ginolo (6/4), Ar Aghaidh Leat (10/1), Mickey Viking (12/1), Crock's Bottom (14/1), Gold Hill (20/1)

races.title: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Amateur Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: CADILLAC RANCH is relatively unexposed for one at this level and has built up a good rapport with his amateur rider. He gets the nod over Market House , who looks to have solid claims under Alex Chadwick, with Prairie Diamond and Rip Wheeler also worth considering in a tricky betting heat. CADILLAC RANCH (IRE) MARKET HOUSE (IRE) PRAIRIE DIAMOND (IRE)

races.title: John Weight Gone But Not Forgotten Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: CREST OF STARS made a promising start to his chasing career over C&D 11 days ago and expected to build on that, he looks the way to go. Icare Grandchamp 's record fresh is a positive one so he's feared as a previous C&D winner, while Clap of Thunder and Ionian also have something to recommend them. CREST OF STARS (IRE) ICARE GRANDCHAMP (FR) CLAP OF THUNDER (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Crest Of Stars (11/4), Icare Grandchamp (7/2), Ionian (4/1), Clap Of Thunder (9/2), Siam Park (5/1), Reteti (10/1)

races.title: 'Anyone Want A Drink? Anyone?' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: KAMILLE AU KANADA may well be headed for better things so a 4-timer looks likely. Last-time-out winners Norman Fletcher and Tune In A Box are the likely dangers off unchanged marks. KAMILLE AU KANADA (FR) NORMAN FLETCHER TUNE IN A BOX (IRE)

races.title: More Radio Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: In a weak race, EPHYRA is chanced from a mark that looks workable on last season’s course second given she should be sharper for her recent return. In-form chase winner Golly Gosh is feared most despite stamina concerns at this longer trip, with Anothermanicmonday also respected. EPHYRA GOLLY GOSH (IRE) ANOTHERMANICMONDAY (IRE)

races.title: Docker Hughes Memorial Race Handicap Chase
races.verdict: UNCLE AL jumped better than usual when routing Daring Plan at Fontwell last time and looks capable of confirming that superiority despite meeting that rival on 5 lb worse terms, even if Susan Gardner’s charge should get closer. Back It Up is hard to weigh up but could improve for the fitting of a visor. UNCLE AL (IRE) DARING PLAN (IRE) BACK IT UP (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Uncle Al (10/11), Daring Plan (3/1), Back It Up (9/2), Walkinthewoods (7/1), Sopran Thor (50/1)

races.title: Neville Hall 60th Birthday Celebration Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: SIR EDWARD LEAR left previous efforts over hurdles behind when fourth at Huntingdon recently and capable of better again now handicapping, James Owen's 5-y-o gets the verdict. Bobbi's Beauty hasn't been seen in this sphere since spring 2024 but arriving on the back of a recent win over fences, she's put forward as the main threat. Kotari looks best of the rest. SIR EDWARD LEAR BOBBI'S BEAUTY (IRE) KOTARI (FR)
